name: neutral_ppo_eval
purpose: Evaluate the hierarchical DQN tactical policy while replacing PPO raw normalized continuous outputs with a neutral five-control vector.
safety_notes: Do not change the DQN tactical policy.
Neutral raw PPO vector [0, 0, 0, 0, 0] maps to reorder_fraction=0.50, dispatch_intensity=0.50, speed_multiplier=1.00, safety_stock_multiplier=1.50, capacity_buffer_fraction=0.25.
